Sample Order Manual
Client :Classic Fashion

# Introduction
This document describes about the working of Sample Order related transaction in wfx system.

### Business Case.
This business case elaborate functioning of Sample Order transactions such as Creating a sample Order, Sample BOM, sample Supplier PO Creation, Sample Receipt/Dispatch.
Step 1: Path
Sales -> Sample Order-> New Sample Order.
Below is the transactional screen shot of New Sample Order.
We can copy style information and SWN information from below options.
Once we will click on copy below screen will come.
Copy and create new style: - This option will facilitate users to copy style information and creates new techpack after confirmation.
Copy and create variant: - This option will facilitate users to copy style information and creates new techpack after confirmation, and maintains a link between parent style and copied styles.
Copy Style: - This option will facilitate users to copy style information without creating new techpack after confirmation.
Copy sample order: - This option will facilitate users to copy sample information without creating new techpack after confirmation.
Above screen is New Sample Order where user will fill all the necessary details which are explained below.
Sample Order No.:-It is system generated
Created On: -sample Order Creation date
Article Code: -Here user will enter article Code
Buyer: - Buyer Name
Buyer Department: Buyer Department
Season: Season
Supplier Name: Supplier Name will come here
Buyer Contact: - Name of the responsible person from buyer side who is looking after the style
Supplier Contact: Name of the responsible person from Supplier side who is looking after the style
Worksheet Recd. On: Date on which sample order given by buyer.
Buyer Delivery Date: Buyer Delivery date
Style Details: Style details to be filled here
Material Type: Material type
Fabric/Main Material: Main material name
Product Group/Sub Category: Product Group/Sub Category
Gender: Gender
Article Description: Style description
Buyer Target Price: Buyer Target Price
Buyer Quoted Price: Buyer Quoted Price
Supplier Quoted Price: Supplier Quoted Price
UOM: UOM
Internal Reference: Internal Reference
Wash Type: Wash Type
Product Finishing: Product Finishing
Iron Type: Iron Type
Embroidery Type: Embroidery Type
Print Type: Print Type
Master Style: Main Master Style
After filling all the above fields there is an another option on the same screen as “Sample Order Details” Where user will first select the required Sizes for which he/she has to create a sample and after that user will click on “ADD” button as shown in below screenshot.
After selecting the “Required Sizes”, clicking on “ADD” Button the screen will show all the related details to be filled by the user.
Fields in red are mandatory to be filled. After user fills all the details he/she will click on “Confirm” at the top of the page.
Once the user Confirm the sample Order, all the details filled by him will come on the next screen which is known as “Sample Order View Screen “where the user will Create the “Bill of material”
After clicking on the “Bill of Material” below screen will appear where user will find three option to create “BOM”.
1 Create New BOM using Layout:- In this option users can select any existing layout and create BOM.
2.Copy From Article:- This option facilitates users to copy BOM from another article sampling BOM.
3.Copy from this articles Production Bill of Material:- This option facilitates users to copy BOM, if current sample order style is copied from existing style.
After selecting one of the above option User will click on “Ok” button
For example: - We are taking the first option i.e. Create New BOM using Layout.
After clicking on OK button the above screen will come where user will find two categories (Fabric and Trims) because here the BOM layout user has selected includes only two categories, it will vary on the Type of BOM Layout selected by the user.
After that the user will click on the “Add Button” and will fill all the details such as Article, Body Type, Color, Size, UOM, Consumption Qty, wastage, Product Qty etc.
Once users will specify all required informations. He/she will click on “View Requirement”
After user clicks on the “View Requirements” below screen will appear where user has to check all the details, after checking all details user will click on “Release Requirements” so that Indents can be generated where user will fullfill indent(requirement).
Once the requirement is Released and indent will be generated in the indent list.
Path
Sourcing -> Indent Management -> User Indent List
Once the Indent List Opens you will find your Indents there.
Note: -For Indent Fulfilment and receiving material Please refer Indent Management and inventory Manual.
Once the sample is ready in the Sample Room user has to receive the sample from the Sample Room so that he/she can Dispatch it to the buyer, that transaction is explained in the below screen shot.
Path: - Sales -> Sample Order -> Sample Receipt.
The above screen is used to create Sample Receipt for the sample order.
Once user goes to the screen he/she will find the below screen where user will fill all the necessary details so that he/she can receive his/her sample Orders from the Sample room.
Here in the above screen user will fill the Supplier, supplier Document Ref No and the Site where he/she wants to receive the sample. After that user will click on the “ADD” button where he/she will add sample orders which belongs to him/her. In this Sample Order Orders screen user can select multiple sample orders.
Once sample orders are selected then user will click on “Confirm”
After that the below screen will appear. Where all the details filled by the users will appear.
User can find his/her sample order Receipt in the Sample Receipt List.
Path: - Sales->Sample Order->Sample Receipt List.
Sample Order Receipt List.
Once the Receipt is completed now the user is ready to Dispatch the sample to the buyer.
For Dispatch user has two Dispatch Options.
1.Sample Courier Dispatch: - for dispatching sample through courier user will select this option.
Path -> Sales -> Sample Order -> sample Courier Dispatch.
Fill all the details, select your order and Confirm.
2.Sample Forwarder Dispatch: -Here for Dispatching sample orders user will select forwarder.
Path -> Sales -> Sample Order -> sample Forwarder Dispatch.
Below is the Forwarder dispatch screen.
Note: - When user sends the sample to the buyer on dispatch screen there is an option “Type” where two radio buttons are given to mark the sample as
• Returnable
• Non-Returnable
Non-returnable: - If we select non-returnable type then we cannot receive any of the samples which buyer is returning back.
Returnable: - - If we select returnable type then we can receive any of the samples which buyer is returning back. Here user will do one more transection i.e. Buyer Returned Sample Receipt. In order to receive the buyer dispatched sample.
Path -> Sales -> Sample Order -> Buyer Returned Sample Receipt.
Buyer Returned Sample Receipt screen shot shown below.
Once the user done with the buyer returned sample Receipt transection then it will reflect in the Buyer Returned Sample Receipt list.
Path -> Sales -> Sample Order -> Buyer Returned Sample Receipt List.
If the user wants to see the number of dispatch order he/she can go and see it in the dispatch order list.
Path -> Sales -> Sample Order -> sample Dispatch List.
Below is the Sample Order Dispatch List.
For creating Invoices against courier dispatches user will create Courier invoice
Path Sales>Sample order > Courier Invoice
After clicking on courier invoice below screen will come.
Here user can consolidate multiple dispatches and create one courier dispatch as shown in below screenshot.
After selecting dispatches user will click on “OK” and confirm
